notes: https://www.flipkartcareers.com/ publishes one TurboHire career page for Flipkart Internet Private Limited. The page's data comes from POST https://thapi.azurewebsites.net/api/careerpagev2/filteredjobs (bearer token from /api/token/noauth, Origin/Referer flipkart.turbohire.co) with a JSON body containing Keyword, Department, Locations, JobTypes, JobTypeV2, Experience, CreatedDate, Compensation, Skills, BunitIds and SortByV2. The adapter sends all filters empty to enumerate the board, then filters locally.
